en.bdb: Powers and virtues of the Guru

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਾਸਿ ਸੁਵਾਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਿੰਮਲਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: vaas suvaas nivaas kar si(n)mal gurmukh sukh fal laae|

en.bdb: Diffusing in all the places like fragrance, the gurmukh makes even the mind oriented, manmukh, fragrant by giving him pleasure-fruit.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਇਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਮਨੂਰੁ ਮਿਲੁ ਕਾਗਹੁ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਰਵਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: soinaa hoi manoor mil kaagahu param ha(n)s karavaae|

en.bdb: He transforms iron slag into gold and the crows into the swans of highest order (param hails).

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤਹੁ ਦੇਵ ਕਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਭੈ ਪਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: pasoo paretahu dhev kar satigur dhev sev bhai paae|

en.bdb: Consequent to the service of the true Guru, animals and ghosts also become gods.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਰਖਿ ਸੰਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਲੈ ਲੈ ਹਥਿ ਵਜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: sabh nidhaan rakh sa(n)kh vich har jee lai lai hath vajaae|

en.bdb: Having all the treasures in His hand (conch) He goes on distributing them with his hand among the people day and night.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਹੋਇ ਆਪੁ ਛਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: patit udhaaran aakheeaai bhagat vachhal hoi aap chhalaae|

en.bdb: Called as the redeemer of the sinners, the Lord, loving to the devotees, gets Himself deluded by the devotees.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਰੇ ਜਗੁ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: gun keete gun kare jag avagun keete gun gur bhaae|

en.bdb: The whole world is good towards the wellwisher alone, but, the Guru loves to do good even to the evil doer.
Guru has come to the world as a benevolent entity.
